description: This coastal walk takes you along Rascarrel Bay on the Solway Firth. You can start your walk from the car parking area on the eastern side the bay. Head west along the path and it will take you along the path to Castle Muir Point. Along the way there are wonderful sea views, beaches and lots of wildlife to see. You can continue your walking on the circularBalcary Bay Walkwhere there's some fine views of Auchencairn Bay and Hestan Island to enjoy. There's also the nearbyTorr Point Walkat Auchencairn village to the north east.
